findings: Registered hotspot paths, discovery roots, and manifest paths were not all protected against traversal and symlink components before reads.
The 7,856-line docs/frontend/implementation/browser-continuity.mjs harness was outside discovery roots; the e2e root was also outside discovery.

fixes: Validate manifest path, configured roots, and registered file paths component by component with lstat; require paths to be contained in the canonical repository root and final files to be regular non-symlinks before reading.
Add regression tests for traversal, a symlinked manifest, a symlinked discovery ancestor, and symlinked registered files.
Discover e2e and docs/frontend/implementation; register browser-continuity.mjs with a first-capture cap of 7,856 lines; ignore generated vite-cache directories.

unexpected_setup_access.detail: An earlier accidental run through the repository root Vitest config entered tests/setup/global-setup.ts and made only two read-only SQL queries: a pg_database existence check and SELECT 1. The setup skipped creation, reset, migrations, seed, grants, and cleanup. The focused suite was later rerun with the evidence config that omits global setup. No database action was repeated during this review or remediation.

limitations: The first measured size is the initial cap for 20 newly inventoried files; no historical decreases are claimed for those files.
The guard tracks large-file ownership and growth but does not itself decompose registered modules; related M-21/M-22 work remains scoped separately.
Owner codes identify logical responsibilities and do not constitute human acceptance or release approval.
The worktree remains dirty and no candidate SHA, CI, target, or UAT evidence is asserted.

independent_review.findings: The manifest, configured roots, and hotspot paths are safely contained and validated before reads. Discovery covers e2e and docs/frontend/implementation and excludes vite-cache. The 26 discovered files reconcile against 28 registered entries; 0 are unregistered, all 28 are within budget, ranks and owners match, and all measurements reconcile.
